Author: Subhash Chandra Sharma
Bench: Subhash Chandra Sharma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 82
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 13234 of 2022
Applicant :- Aditya Kumar Singh

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Mohit Singh,Anil Kumar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for State and perused the record.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that he is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The victim was major at the time of alleged incident.

There was love affair between the present applicant and the victim and with her consent physical relations were established between both of them but later on she insisted on entering into marriage with him that was refused by the applicant,
as a result present F.I.R. was lodged against him and his parents.

Further submitted that the incident is said to have taken place in the year 2019 under influence of intoxication though there is nothing on record to show that the applicant established physical relations with the victim after administering intoxicant substance.

It is also submitted that the marriage between the applicant and the victim was refused by his parents, as a result present F.I.R.
was lodged for making pressure on him.

It is also submitted that all these facts were not taken into Aditya Kumar Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181805509/
1 consideration by the Investigating Officer during investigation of the case even though the applicant moved application before the Superintendent of Police regarding this case but charge sheet was submitted against him under Section 376 IPC ignoring the fact of consensual relation between the applicant and the victim.

entities.text: Aditya Kumar Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant challenged the charge sheet before this Court in an application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. which was dismissed vide order dated 28.1.2022 and applicant could not appear before the learned court on account of interim protection granted in his favour by this Court.
There is apprehension of arrest against the applicant, so request for anticipatory bail during pendency of trial.

On the other hand, learned AGA opposed the prayer of anticipatory bail and urged that the applicant established physical relations with the victim without her consent by administering intoxicating substance though there was friendship between both of them and he also promised to marry with her but later on refused.
In this way, consent cannot be said to be obtained freely.
Further urged that charge sheet was submitted in the year 2019 and cognizance was taken in the year 2020.

Process was also issued against him but he did not appear before the learned court as a result N.B.W. was issued against him on 3.3.2021 and even after N.B.W. he did not appear before the learned court but was avoiding the process that was the reason several letters were written to the S.P. to ensure the presence of the applicant even though he is absconding
, therefore, he is not entitled for anticipatory bail.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, perusal of record, conduct of the applicant in avoiding the trial and absconding, there appears no ground to grant anticipatory bail in favour of the applicant.

The anticipatory bail application of applicant Aditya Kumar Singh involved in Case No. 8437 of 2020 arising out of Case Crime No. 236 of 2019, under Section 376 IPC, P.S. Shahpur, District Gorakhpur is hereby rejected.

Order Date :- 20.4.2023 A. Singh  Aditya Kumar Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181805509/
